knobs.name: sP1
knobs.what: world units per orbit unit: radius of the planets' ring (the position view)

knobs.name: zDec
knobs.what: world units per tenfold of steps: the height of the column (each decade of steps is one band)

knobs.name: sT
knobs.what: radius of the fully stretched energy drift (the sorted view of the two steppers)

knobs.name: errFloor
knobs.what: log10 of the smallest energy drift that shows: the stretch of the error, a look, never a number

knobs.name: farSqueeze
knobs.what: how far the thrown-out planets are drawn from the ring in the position view (log squeeze)

knobs.name: sW
knobs.what: world units per unit of the weight picture (the network, before its sort)

knobs.name: sC
knobs.what: world units per unit of the layer gap: the radius of the network's shells

knobs.name: sQ
knobs.what: world units per unit of the spring's position and momentum (the toy pair's ring)

knobs.name: zStep2
knobs.what: world units between two snapshots of the toy pair (the height of its column)

knobs.name: driftGain
knobs.what: how much the toy networks' energy drift is stretched for the eye (a look, said in words)

knobs.name: sK
knobs.what: world units per unit of the air: the size of the stirred loop

knobs.name: chainR
knobs.what: radius of the stand-in chain (world units)

knobs.name: arrowLen
knobs.what: length of the longest answer arrow on the chain (world units)

knobs.name: arrowEvery
knobs.what: one answer arrow per this many residues

knobs.name: turnAx
knobs.what: tilt of the turning axis, x part (the chain turns about (x, 1, z))

knobs.name: turnAz
knobs.what: tilt of the turning axis, z part

knobs.name: turns
knobs.what: how many full turns the chain makes

knobs.name: dotR1
knobs.what: dot radius of the 2,000 planet snapshots (world units, before the depth cue)

knobs.name: dotR2
knobs.what: dot radius of the 10,000 network dots

knobs.name: dotR3
knobs.what: dot radius of the 400 toy-network dots

knobs.name: dotR4
knobs.what: dot radius of the stirred loop's parcels

knobs.name: dotR5
knobs.what: dot radius of the stand-in chain's residues

knobs.name: dotRW
knobs.what: dot radius in the wide frame (the four small clouds)

knobs.name: planetR
knobs.what: radius of the two planets drawn as single dots

knobs.name: wireR
knobs.what: radius of the faint orbit's dots

knobs.name: followGrow
knobs.what: how much bigger the two followed dots are drawn (0 = same size)

knobs.name: followK
knobs.what: which snapshot of the keeper is followed (0 = the first, 999 = the last)

knobs.name: followRun
knobs.what: which of the 100 training runs is followed (drawn brighter)

knobs.name: runDim
knobs.what: how far the other 99 runs sink once one run is followed (0 = not at all)

knobs.name: sizeCue
knobs.what: depth size cue: nearer dots drawn bigger (0 = none)

knobs.name: fog
knobs.what: fog toward the far side (0 = none)

knobs.name: stag
knobs.what: stagger of the re-plot: how much each dot's start is delayed (the same dots, never fewer)

knobs.name: ghostDim
knobs.what: how far the ghost clouds sink toward the ground (the wide frame, the first pose)

knobs.name: perS
knobs.what: seconds per lap of the two planets in the first 26 seconds

knobs.name: fov
knobs.what: camera field of view (degrees)

knobs.name: lensX
knobs.what: lens shift that keeps the cloud in the left two thirds (0 = centred)

knobs.name: lensY
knobs.what: lens shift, vertical

knobs.name: lensXWide
knobs.what: lens shift in the wide frame (the wide frame looks from behind, so left and right are mirrored: the clouds are placed to read planets, network, air, chain left to right)

knobs.name: lensYWide
knobs.what: lens shift in the wide frame, vertical

knobs.name: camHookAz
knobs.what: hook camera azimuth: the planets' ring (degrees)

knobs.name: camHookEl
knobs.what: hook camera elevation (degrees)

knobs.name: camHookDist
knobs.what: hook camera distance

knobs.name: camS1Az
knobs.what: azimuth of the planet column before the re-plot (chosen so the thrown-out planets, which all leave in one direction, end on the right)

knobs.name: camS1El
knobs.what: elevation of the planet column before the re-plot: the belief, from above

knobs.name: camS1Dist
knobs.what: distance to the planet column

knobs.name: camM1Az
knobs.what: how far the camera orbits during the first re-plot (degrees)

knobs.name: camM1Dist
knobs.what: distance the first re-plot lands on (the camera moves in a little)

knobs.name: camM1El
knobs.what: elevation the first re-plot lands on: from the side

knobs.name: camS2Az
knobs.what: azimuth of the network cloud

knobs.name: camS2El
knobs.what: elevation of the network cloud

knobs.name: camS2Dist
knobs.what: distance to the network cloud

knobs.name: camM3Az
knobs.what: how far the camera orbits during the network re-plot (degrees)

knobs.name: camS2bAz
knobs.what: azimuth of the two toy networks

knobs.name: camS2bEl
knobs.what: elevation of the two toy networks

knobs.name: camS2bDist
knobs.what: distance to the two toy networks

knobs.name: camS3Az
knobs.what: azimuth of the stirred loop

knobs.name: camS3El0
knobs.what: elevation over the flat ring at the start of the loop

knobs.name: camS3Dist0
knobs.what: distance to the flat ring

knobs.name: camS3El1
knobs.what: elevation at the end of the crane over the loop

knobs.name: camS3Dist1
knobs.what: distance at the end of the crane

knobs.name: camM4Az
knobs.what: how far the camera swings during the crane (degrees)

knobs.name: camS4Az
knobs.what: azimuth of the chain

knobs.name: camS4El
knobs.what: elevation of the chain

knobs.name: camS4Dist
knobs.what: distance to the chain

knobs.name: camWideAz
knobs.what: azimuth of the wide frame

knobs.name: camWideEl
knobs.what: elevation of the wide frame

knobs.name: camWideDist
knobs.what: distance of the wide frame

knobs.name: camWideCY
knobs.what: height the wide frame looks at

knobs.name: wideOff
knobs.what: spacing of the four small clouds in the wide frame

knobs.name: pX
knobs.what: left edge of the readout panel (sheet units)

knobs.name: honestY
knobs.what: top line of the honest line (sheet units)

knobs.name: tQ
knobs.what: when the question comes up (seconds)

knobs.name: tTwo
knobs.what: when the second planet appears (seconds)

knobs.name: cin1T0
knobs.what: the planets' snapshots start to arrive (seconds)

knobs.name: cin1T1
knobs.what: all 1,000 snapshots of each stepper are there (seconds)

knobs.name: m1T0
knobs.what: first re-plot starts: place -> what should stay (seconds)

knobs.name: m1T1
knobs.what: first re-plot ends (seconds)

knobs.name: tS2a
knobs.what: cut to the network (seconds)

knobs.name: cin2T0
knobs.what: the network's dots start to arrive (seconds)

knobs.name: cin2T1
knobs.what: all the network's dots are there (seconds)

knobs.name: m3T0
knobs.what: network re-plot starts (seconds)

knobs.name: m3T1
knobs.what: network re-plot ends (seconds)

knobs.name: tS2b
knobs.what: cut to the two toy networks (seconds)

knobs.name: cin3T0
knobs.what: the toy networks' dots start to arrive (seconds)

knobs.name: cin3T1
knobs.what: all 400 toy-network dots are there (seconds)

knobs.name: tS3
knobs.what: cut to the stirred loop (seconds)

knobs.name: m4T0
knobs.what: crane over the loop starts, after the stirring (seconds)

knobs.name: m4T1
knobs.what: crane ends: the wall seen from the side, its top flat (seconds)

knobs.name: tS4
knobs.what: cut to the chain (seconds)

knobs.name: cin4T0
knobs.what: the chain's dots start to arrive (seconds)

knobs.name: cin4T1
knobs.what: all the chain's dots are there (seconds)

knobs.name: m5T0
knobs.what: the chain starts to turn (seconds)

knobs.name: m5T1
knobs.what: the chain has turned once (seconds)

knobs.name: tWide
knobs.what: cut to the wide frame (seconds)

knobs.name: tHonest
knobs.what: the honest line comes up (seconds)

knobs.name: pinA0
knobs.what: first pin (the keeper's dot) comes up (seconds)

knobs.name: pinB0
knobs.what: second pin (the plain planet's dot) replaces it (seconds)

knobs.name: pinB1
knobs.what: the pin goes (seconds)

knobs.name: pinN0
knobs.what: the network's shell pin comes up (seconds)

knobs.name: pinN1
knobs.what: the network's pin goes (seconds)

knobs.name: pinR0
knobs.what: the starting-ring pin comes up (seconds)

knobs.name: pinR1
knobs.what: the starting-ring pin goes (seconds)

knobs.name: pinRAz
knobs.what: where on the starting ring the pin points (degrees round the ring)

knobs.name: stirT0
knobs.what: the stirring starts (the camera is still over the loop) (seconds)

knobs.name: stirT1
knobs.what: the stirring ends: the loop has stretched and folded (seconds)

knobs.name: wallH
knobs.what: height of the wall at the start: the swirl's start value (world units); later heights are the computed swirl over its start value

knobs.name: wallA
knobs.what: opacity of the wall

knobs.name: wallEdge
knobs.what: line width of the wall's top edge

knobs.name: flungLen
knobs.what: length of the outward arrow at the thrown-out planets (world units)

knobs.name: arrowW
knobs.what: line width of the answer arrows and the outward arrow

knobs.name: trackW
knobs.what: line width of the followed run's track

knobs.name: walkR
knobs.what: radius of the followed run's dot walking its track

knobs.name: tagAdv
knobs.what: advance per character of the tag's lay line (Space Mono 14 at letter-spacing 1), for the coloured words
